title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Gloucester
Working Pattern: Hybrid

A great opportunity has arisen for an Accounts Assistant to join a busy finance team based in central Gloucester.

The role will support the wider finance function across Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable, including processing invoices, managing payments, reconciliations and dealing with supplier and customer queries.

Key Responsibilities:
- Supporting day-to-day AP and AR processes
- Processing invoices and payments
- Account and bank reconciliations
- Managing supplier and customer queries
- Supporting the wider finance team with general duties

About You:
- Previous AP and/or AR experience
- Good attention to detail
- Confident working with Excel and finance systems
- Organised and able to manage deadlines
- Good communication skills

Salary: £26,000-£27,000 + hybrid working.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

title: French speaking Payroll & HR Coordinator
description:
Job Title: French speaking Payroll & HR Coordinator

Location: Cirencester, hybrid after probation

Contract: Permanent, full-time, Monday - Friday: 8.30am - 5pm with early finishes on Fridays

Salary: £40,000-45,000 DOE + discretionary annual bonus

Our growing international client is a leader in the medtech industry and is on the lookout for a French speaking Payroll & HR Coordinator professional to join them during their exciting growth period!

In this role, you'll be supporting the accurate and timely processing of payroll, focussing on the French market, acting as a first point of contact for payroll and benefits queries from employees and managers, and supporting the company's global HR department.

Why join:
- An annual salary of £40,000-45,000 DOE + discretionary annual bonus
- Join a global, leading company during their growth period and make a direct impact on healthcare
- Excellent opportunities for growth and progression, including support with achieving your CIPP
- Free breakfast and canteen lunches with hot and cold meals
- Hybrid working following successful completion of probationary period, 3x days on-site
- Generous pension, going up to 9.7% after 18 months
- Private medical insurance with BUPA for you and your family
- Passionate, friendly, collaborative and international company culture with a shared goal
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- And more!

As the French speaking Payroll & HR Coordinator, you'll:
- Support the accurate and timely processing of payroll, focussing on the French market
- Maintain employee and payroll data, ensuring accuracy and compliance
- Process payroll changes, including new starters, leavers, salary adjustments, benefits and absences
- Act as a first point of contact for payroll and benefits queries from employees and managers
- Administer employee benefits and support monthly payroll reporting
- Assist with payroll audits, reconciliations, and HR administration tasks
- Collaborate with HR, Finance and external payroll providers to ensure smooth operations

Who we're looking for:
- Native-level French speaker with fluent English
- 2+ years of experience in French payroll processes and legislation
- High level of attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills
- Solution-based approach

If this sounds like you, please apply either directly or reach out to Aylin at for a confidential chat to find out more.

Candidates must hold full right to work status for the UK, without requiring sponsorship for the foreseeable future.

Please be advised CVs will be treated in the strictest of confidence and that your application will not be forwarded without your permission.

We aim to respond promptly; however, due to the high level of applications, we are only able to contact candidates to applicants whose experience closely matches our client's requirements.

For more opportunities, please visit our website.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Robert Half are exclusively working with a long-established, family-focused business in the heart of the Cotswolds to recruit a Payroll Administrator. The company is growing and modernising, and it's investing in its people and services while staying true to its community values. You'll be the go-to person for accurate weekly payroll data. You'll also give the wider operations team practical administrative support, so this suits someone who likes variety and being close to the day-to-day.

Payroll Administrator
Salary: £35,000 per annum
Location: Bourton-on-the-Water, Cotswolds
Contract: Permanent, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

Key responsibilities
- Prepare and submit accurate weekly operational and payroll data for frontline colleagues
- Check clocking records against scheduled duties, investigating and resolving any discrepancies
- Manage holiday allocation for colleagues in line with business needs
- Act as a first point of contact for colleague queries by phone, email and in person
- Work closely with HR on colleague administration, including starters, leavers and employee updates
- Support day-to-day site operations, assisting the operations team when required
- Handle justified complaints through informal discussions
- Order and distribute uniform, and maintain the related records
- Manage petty cash, prepaid cards, cash machine issues and cash variances
- Keep accurate records, update internal systems and complete general administrative duties
- Support the wider team and promote company values at all times

About you
- Experience in payroll administration, including checking and correcting payroll data
- Experience working within a finance team
- Strong Excel skills and familiarity with rota systems
- Strong communication and teamwork skills, with excellent attention to detail
- Able to prioritise your workload, meet deadlines and work independently
- Reliable, punctual and flexible when the business needs it

What's on offer
- £35,000 per annum
- Holiday purchase scheme
- 20 days' annual leave plus bank holidays
- Pension scheme
- Lifestyle benefits
- Employee assistance programme
- Career development opportunities within the wider group

How to apply

Robert Half is working exclusively with the company on this role. To apply, please send your CV via the link or contact the Oxford office for a confidential conversation.

Robert Half Ltd acts as an employment business for temporary positions and an employment agency for permanent positions. Robert Half is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. Suitable candidates with equivalent qualifications and more or less experience can apply. Rates of pay and salary ranges are dependent upon your experience, qualifications and training. title: Payroll Officer
description:
Payroll Officer

Tewkesbury - 1 day WFH

£35,000

Our Tewkesbury manufacturing client is seeking an experienced finance professional to join the Finance team in a role that will have a strong focus on payroll administration and financial accounting.

This position would suit an individual who has previous experience working within a payroll, finance, or accounting environment and is looking to develop their career within a dynamic manufacturing business. The successful candidate will take ownership of key payroll processes while supporting financial reporting, controls, and compliance activities.

Working closely with Finance, HR, and operational teams, you will play a critical role in ensuring payroll accuracy, maintaining financial controls, and supporting the delivery of timely and accurate financial information.
Key responsibilities include:
- Ownership and completion of weekly and monthly payrolls, including management of the Time & Attendance system.
- Processing payroll-related queries and ensuring payroll accuracy and compliance.
- Completion of associated general ledger journals.
- Production of monthly headcount and people-related reporting.
- Recharging of costs within the Group.
- Performing balance sheet reconciliations and investigating variances.
- Assisting with the preparation and submission of quarterly VAT returns.
- Analysing expenditure for Corporation Tax reporting requirements.
- Supporting annual stocktakes.
- Assisting with internal and external audits.
- Identifying opportunities to improve payroll and finance processes.

Candidate profile

The ideal candidate will have experience in a similar role and ideally be AAT qualified and/or actively studying towards ACCA, CIMA or similar. You will also have:
- A good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft packages.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to offer a high level of customer service and build strong working relationships with internal customers.
- Ability to retain and not share confidential information
- Be efficient, proactive, self-motivated, highly organised with good attention to detail.
- Numerical accuracy and understand the importance of confidentiality.

We are happy to provide application and/or accessibility support, please contact your Marks Sattin or Grafton consultant directly to discuss your needs. We're committed to protecting the privacy of all our candidates and clients, please visit and for our privacy policy.

title: Purchase Ledger
description:
Purchase ledger clerk/Accounts Assistant required for a 6 month contract to take charge of invoicing, payments and reconciliations ensuring the smooth flow of financial transactions across the business.
The role is based in Gloucestershire GL56 for 5 days a week with the option to work from home once a week after a successful training period.

We are looking for an experienced Accounts Payable Clerk with strong Excel skills to support the efficient running of the purchase ledger function. The ideal candidate will be highly analytical, detail-focused, and confident handling large datasets.

Key Responsibilities:
Processing high volumes of purchase invoices accurately and efficiently
Matching, batching, and coding invoices to the correct accounts
Performing supplier statement reconciliations and resolving discrepancies
Managing supplier queries in a timely and professional manner
Preparing and assisting with weekly/monthly payment runs
Maintaining accurate and up-to-date financial records
Using Excel to analyse data, track invoices, and support reporting
Identifying process improvements and increasing efficiency within AP

Excel & Technical Requirements:
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including:
Pivot tables
VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP
Data filtering and sorting
Basic formulas (SUMIF, COUNTIF, etc.)
Experience working with accounting systems (e.g., Sage, Xero, or similar)
Ability to manage and reconcile large volumes of data

Skills & Experience:
Proven experience in an Accounts Payable or Purchase Ledger role
High level of accuracy and attention to detail
Strong organisational and time management skills
Good communication skills for liaising with suppliers and internal teams
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
